findings: HAL_MDF_AcqStop_DMA calls HAL_DMA_Abort before disabling filter.
HAL_DMA_Abort suspends then resets channel, clears HT/TC/error flags and sets CBR1=0 for linked list. Residual count cannot be read after this call.
HAL_DMAEx_Suspend preserves snapshot but sets state SUSPEND; HAL_DMA_Abort requires BUSY, so naive Suspend then AcqStop_DMA fails.

Reconcile already-enqueued halves versus pending boundary flags; detect missed wraps/overrun rather than claim lossless recovery.
Account for ADF output FIFO at selected stop boundary and validate sample loss contract.
Do not globally mask SysTick around polling HAL functions with tick-based timeouts.
Only after final tail encrypted/closed/synced and FS unmounted send DEVICE_RELEASED.
